description: All Work Breakdown Structure task codes for a given project, sorted by flat code. NOTE, this endpoint is currently in the experimental stage and is subject to change.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of task codes to return

enum: all (returns both labor and equipment task codes in a single request)

parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description: Selects the response blueprint. Defaults to `task_code_entity` (full detail); `id_only` returns only identifiers. Takes precedence over the `view` parameter.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Selects the response blueprint. Defaults to `task_code_entity` (full detail); `id_only` returns only identifiers. Ignored when `serializer_view` is also provided.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter criteria for WBS task codes.

id.description: Filter by one or more WBS task code identifiers.

updated_at.description: Return only task codes updated on or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

budgeted.description: When true, returns only task codes whose associated cost code is budgeted; when false, only non-budgeted.

id.description: Unique identifier of the WBS task code.

budgeted.description: Whether this task code is flagged as budgeted.

cost_code.description: The cost code associated with this task code.

id.description: Unique identifier of the cost code.

biller.description: Name of the billing entity (project or sub job) this cost code is billed to.

biller_id.description: Identifier of the billing entity. Null when no biller is assigned.

biller_type.description: Type of the billing entity. Empty string when no biller is assigned.

biller_origin_id.description: Third-party origin identifier for the billing entity. Null when not sourced from an external system.

budgeted.description: Whether this cost code is flagged as budgeted.

code.description: Short code for this cost code, without parent prefixes.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this cost code was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this cost code was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

full_code.description: Full hierarchical cost code including all parent prefixes (e.g., 02-300).

name.description: Display name of the cost code.

origin_data.description: Arbitrary data from the third-party system that originally created this cost code. Null when not externally sourced.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this cost code in its originating third-party system. Null when not externally sourced.

parent.description: Parent cost code in the hierarchy.

position.description: Sort position of this cost code among its siblings.

sortable_code.description: Sortable code (this property is deprecated - see full_code)

standard_cost_code_id.description: Identifier of the standard cost code this was derived from. Null if not linked to a standard cost code.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this cost code was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

line_item_types.description: Budget line item types associated with this cost code.

description.description: Human-readable description of this task code.

flat_code.description: Flattened hierarchical code combining all segment codes (e.g., 02-411).

flat_name.description: Flattened display name combining all segment names.

production_quantity_code_id.description: Identifier of the associated production quantity WBS code. Null if none is linked.
